english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for things that are alike or comparable in everyday situations.

examples.english: The functions of these two phones are similar.
examples.traditional: 呢兩款手機嘅功能差唔多。
examples.jyutping: nei1 loeng5 fun2 sau2 gei1 ge3 gung1 nang4 caa1 m4 do1

english.note: Use 差唔多 when something is almost right or nearly equal, not for physical distance.
Use 差唔多 for approximate amounts or times and for saying that something is almost finished or almost identical.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 caa1 m4 do1 zou6 jyun4 laa3
ji4 gaa1 caa1 m4 do1 saam1 dim2 laa3
